en.title: California Halloween Store Shooting Kills One, Wounds Six
en.dek: A Spirit Halloween store in Fairfield, California, was the site of a shooting that left one dead and six injured.
facts: According to Fairfield Police Chief Dan Marshall, one person was killed and six others were wounded at a Spirit Halloween store in Fairfield, California.
The shooting occurred shortly before 8:30pm local time on Oct 30, 2026, at a shopping mall about 76 km northeast of San Francisco.
Marshall reported that at least three of the wounded were in critical condition.
Investigators had not yet identified the suspect or suspects, according to Marshall.
No areas outside the Solano Town Center mall were on lockdown, Marshall said.
body: The shooting occurred at a Spirit Halloween store in Fairfield, California, a shopping mall about 76 km northeast of San Francisco. It happened shortly before 8:30pm local time on Oct 30, 2026. According to Fairfield Police Chief Dan Marshall, one person was killed and six others were hospitalised with gunshot wounds. At least three of the wounded were in critical condition.

Investigators had not yet identified the suspect or suspects, Marshall said late Friday. The crime scene remains active, and the investigation is ongoing, he added. No areas outside the Solano Town Center mall were on lockdown, according to Marshall.

The shooting took place hours before the start of Halloween, which is celebrated on Oct 31 in the United States. The incident was reported by multiple outlets, including Dawn, CNA, and The Straits Times, all citing the same police statements.
en.context: The event happened at a Spirit Halloween store in a shopping mall in Fairfield, California.

problemsFixed: Context contains unsupported claim that Spirit Halloween is a chain that sells costumes and decorations for the holiday; this is not cited in the sources.
